scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
